# DharmaNexus annotations (`dharmanexus_annotations.csv`)

Bibliographic and content notes for texts in this corpus, from the provenance
pass over the DharmaNexus Sanskrit catalog (dharmamitra.org, October 2026).

**These notes were generated by LLMs. Please double-check them before citing.**
Every entry was drafted by Gemini 3.8 Flash from the e-text, its source
headers, OCR'd reference literature, INBUDS and (for about 45% of entries)
web search. About a fifth of the entries were hard cases (unclear edition,
partial coverage, several works in one file) and were re-checked by Claude
Opus; the `reviewed` column says which. Spot checks found occasional
invented secondary editions or translations, mostly in entries that were not
reviewed.

## Keys

`collection` + `file` match the `file` column of `metadata/<collection>.csv`;
for Wikisource, `sub_folder` + `file` match `wikisource.csv`. A corpus file can
have more than one row when DharmaNexus splits it into several texts.

`link` says how the corpus file was matched to the DharmaNexus text:

- `imported`: DharmaNexus imported the text from this repository (commit 222bcc4).
- `text overlap`: DharmaNexus already had the text from elsewhere (GRETIL,
  DSBC, Muktabodha, ...). The DharmaNexus text covers at least 80% of the
  corpus file (`overlap`, by shingles) and the two have similar length.

## Columns

| column | content |
|---|---|
| `dharmanexus_id`, `dharmanexus_url` | the DharmaNexus text |
| `dharmanexus_title`, `dharmanexus_author` | normalised title and author as now used in DharmaNexus |
| `also_known_as` | other titles |
| `coverage`, `coverage_note` | complete / partial / fragment / excerpt / unclear, with the extent |
| `included_works` | when a file contains several works (root text + commentary, ...) |
| `attribution_note` | notes on authorship |
| `edition_used_status`, `edition_used` | printed edition the e-text derives from: determined / probable / not determined |
| `etext` | who produced the e-text |
| `edition_evidence` | why the edition was identified (headers, page markers, catalogue entries, ...) |
| `other_editions`, `translations` | further editions and translations from the reference literature |
| `summary` | short content summary |
| `confidence` | high / medium / low |
| `reviewed` | Gemini only, or Gemini + Claude review |

Multiple values within a cell are separated by ` | `.
